FINANCE COMMITTEE
                                    MINUTES

A meeting of the Finance Committee was held on Tuesday. March 17, 2026, in City Council
Chambers and via electronic meeting, starting at 12:00 p.m. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMM ITTEE MEMBERS: Ken Esquibel, Chairman; Mark Moody; and Jeff White (via
Zoom). Absent: Lawrence Wolfe.

                                                                       .:rr.

                                    AGENDA ITEMS

12.    ORDINANCE —3 READING            —Repealing Ordinance No. 4603, which specified the
       monthly Stormwater Runoff Management System user fee in accordance with Section
       13.32.050 of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming.

Mr. Moody moved to approve on 3 and final reading, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried
by unanimous voice vote.

Amber Ash, Mayor’s Chief of Staff, provided a staff report. Committee members Moody and
White commented on the item. Ward I Councilman, Pete Layboum, also commented on the item.

23.    RESOLUTION Authorizing the City of Cheyenne to approve and submit the Wyoming
                       —




       Division of Victim Services Funding Application for State Fiscal Years 2027 and 2028.
       (SPONSOR MR. ESQUIBEL)
                   -




Mr. Moody moved to adopt, seconded by Mr. White. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Julie Anthony, Police Department Victim Assistance Coordinator, provided a staff report.
Committee member White thanked Ms. Anthony for the work her department does.

24.    CONTRACT MODIFICATIONS:

       b)     Contract Modification #1 to Contract #8267 between the City of Cheyenne and Plan
              One Architects for the Municipal Building Renovation Design project. (General
              Fund Reserves)

Mr. Moody moved to approve in an amount not to exceed $867,050.00, seconded by Mr. White.
Motion carried with Mr. White voting “YES,” Mr. Moody voting “NO,” and Chairman Esquibel
breaking the tie with a “YES” vote.

Adele Bartel, Public Works Staff Engineer, provided a staff report and Craig LaVoy, Public Works
Deputy Director, provided additional information. Chairman Esquibel and committee members
Moody and White commented on the item. Ward I Councilman, Pete Laybourn, also commented
on the item.
